name: Kui
class: Support/Mage — Offensive Support / Crowd Control/Initiate / Early Game

skills.name: Ethereal Outburst
skills.text: Deals area damage upon taking heavy damage in a single hit or after dying.

skills.name: Mortals!
skills.text: Damages and slows nearby enemies. Marks enemies in the inner circle while dealing extra damage and slowing enemies.

skills.name: Join Me
skills.text: Throws a chain hook in the target direction that pulls the target back, dealing damage and marking them. Passive: Defeats and assists permanently boost Health.

skills.name: Into the Void
skills.text: Deals damage multiple times and slows enemies within range. Against marked heroes, the slow effect is upgraded to a stun.
